name: commandbuttons
author: Taako
description: Sticky Discord button panels that hold commands with modal context gathering and automatic reposting.
install_msg: CommandButtons loaded. Use `[p]commandbuttons` to create and manage sticky button panels.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild sticky button panel configuration, message IDs, channel IDs, and command/button mappings. It does not store message content except panel text sent directly to Discord.
